ownership_decision.invariant: Registry owns where a Skill Version's content lives, including which directory of the stored package is that Version's root.

boundary_decision.interaction: Run reads Registry-owned Skill and Version facts through a reader the composition root injects; Run never reaches into Registry storage.

domain_forces: An Agent Plugin arrives as one archive holding several Skills, so a package root is no longer a Skill root.
Every consumer of a stored package had the package root hard-coded, so a Skill imported from a Plugin was created and then refused by packaging, scanning and diffing.
implementation_design.decision: The Version records the directory it was validated from, and the pair of object key and directory travels together as one value so a consumer cannot take the key and forget the directory.
invariants_preserved: Registry owns where a Skill Version's content lives, including which directory of the stored package is that Version's root.
rejected_alternatives: Re-zip each Skill of a Plugin into its own package: it keeps every consumer unchanged but stores content the Creator never supplied, and the Plugin is the unit that was imported.
Let each consumer find the Skill by walking for SKILL.md: a Plugin holds several, so the walk has to guess which one this Version is.

contract_change.summary: The Version facts Registry hands to Run gain the recorded root of the Version inside its stored package.
contract_change.consumer_impact: A consumer that ignores the field keeps the old behaviour, which is correct only for a Version whose root is the package root.

open_questions: The sandbox provider request still carries only the object key, so a Run of a Plugin-sourced Skill installs the whole archive and the agent discovers no Skill. Closing it changes the provider contract and the runtime image, so it is not in this proposal's scope.

approvals.scope: Registry-to-Run version facts: the recorded root of a Skill Version inside its stored package
